codeReview.summary: Clean, well-structured rewrite of buildPlanDraftPrompt() from markdown to JSON output. The implementation follows the json-plan-migration.md guide precisely. The prompt includes a complete JSON example (which is valid JSON — tested), full schema rules for all fields, step decomposition rules, behavioral contract rules, and an explicit 'What NOT to produce' section that forbids legacy markdown artifacts. The planDraftValidationCriteria string was updated from markdown-referencing to JSON-referencing. The plan workflow definition (src/workflows/plan.ts) correctly picks up the new criteria via its import of planDraftValidationCriteria. The research step (step 0) was left completely unchanged. 28 new tests in plan-prompts.test.ts cover JSON schema instructions, absence of markdown template instructions, validation criteria, context propagation, edge cases (missing research, empty decisions), and valid JSON example parsing. 8 existing tests in plan-generates-contract.test.ts and prompts.test.ts were updated to match the new JSON format. All 107 tests in plan-prompts.test.ts pass, and the adjacent test files (plan-generates-contract.test.ts, prompts.test.ts) also pass cleanly. No blocking issues found.

issues.description: The JSON_EXAMPLE only shows one step and one behavioral contract assertion. While sufficient to demonstrate the schema, a second step with cross-references (e.g., a step that depends on the first, or one with no fulfills) would better demonstrate multi-step plans and edge cases. This is a prompt quality suggestion, not a bug.

The prompt says 'Write a single JSON file to: `.flywheel/plans/{type}-{description}.plan.json`' using curly braces for placeholders. Since the file content itself is JSON, workers might confuse the curly-brace placeholder syntax with JSON syntax. Consider using angle brackets like `<type>-<description>` for placeholders instead. Minor readability concern.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The new BC-AREA-NNN assertion ID format (replacing the old VAL-AREA-NNN format used in validation-contract.md) is documented in the prompt but not in AGENTS.md or any shared convention file. Future workers implementing plan-consuming features need to know this format changed.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: src/prompts/plan/draft.ts BEHAVIORAL_CONTRACT_RULES says 'Format BC-{AREA}-{NNN}', but AGENTS.md still references 'VAL-<AREA>-<NNN>' in the Plan file format section (line about fulfills annotations). The migration guide (.factory/library/json-plan-migration.md) documents this, but AGENTS.md should be updated to reflect the new format.

summary: Feature passes review. The buildPlanDraftPrompt() rewrite correctly migrates from markdown to JSON output instructions. The prompt is comprehensive, well-structured, and matches the json-plan-migration.md guide precisely. The JSON example embedded in the prompt is valid JSON. All markdown template instructions have been removed. The validation criteria is updated. The research step is unchanged. Tests are thorough with 28 new cases. Two non-blocking suggestions: (1) a multi-step JSON example would better illustrate complex plans, (2) curly-brace placeholders in the file path could be confused with JSON syntax. One shared state observation: AGENTS.md still references the old VAL-AREA-NNN assertion ID format rather than the new BC-AREA-NNN format.
